help_intro.message: LLM browser automation assistant that lets AI control your browser to accomplish various tasks. omnibot connects LLM clients to your real browser through a local CLI service, enabling web browsing, data extraction, form filling, and other automation operations.

help_install_cli_desc.message: omnibot runs as a local CLI service that LLM clients start automatically. Install the npm package (auto-detects platform):

help_install_cli_tip.message: After installation, use the omnibot command to start the service. Use omnibot doctor to check service status.

help_install_ext_desc.message: If you are reading this help document, the browser extension is already installed. If not, install it from the Chrome Web Store.

help_install_skills_desc.message: omnibot provides browser operation capabilities to different agents through skills. After installing the CLI service, use the omnibot skills install command to install skills for your agent:

help_skills_tip.message: After installing skills, the agent will automatically gain browser page reading, clicking, navigation, and other operation capabilities without additional configuration.

help_hermes_profile_note.message: You need to specify a profile (use hermes profile list to see available profiles):

help_openclaw_note.message: Skills will be installed to ~/.openclaw/skills/ and auto-loaded when OpenClaw starts.

help_workbuddy_note.message: Skills will be installed to ~/.workbuddy/skills/. Start WorkBuddy to use browser automation capabilities.

help_trae_note.message: Skills will be installed to ~/.trae/skills/ (international) or ~/.trae-cn/skills/ (China), auto-loaded when Trae starts.

help_skill_auto_load.message: After installation, $agent$ will automatically load the omnibot skill and gain browser automation capabilities.

help_connection_desc.message: The connection status is shown at the top of the popup:

help_conn_green.message: 🟢 Connected — Extension is properly connected to the CLI service

help_conn_red.message: 🔴 Disconnected — CLI service is not running or port is unreachable

help_conn_troubleshoot.message: If disconnected, ensure the CLI service is running, then click Reconnect.

help_faq_a1.message: A: Ensure the CLI service is running. Run omnibot doctor to check status, wait for the service to start, then click "Reconnect".

help_faq_q4.message: Q: What happens after trial expires?

help_faq_a2.message: A: Chromium-based browsers (Chrome, Edge, Brave, etc.).
